ideas.pitch: A predictive web platform that forecasts harmful algal blooms 3-5 days in advance using oceanographic sensor streams and machine learning.
ideas.title: AquaPulse Burgas: Coastal Algal Bloom Early Warning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Climate & Ocean Intelligence domain and mirrors the exact architecture of proven past winners in marine IoT prediction.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered agricultural platform featuring crop disease detection with offline SMS fallback alerts for rural farmers with low connectivity.
ideas.title: AgriConnect Offline SMS: AI Crop Disease & Market Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the real-world connectivity hurdle in rural agriculture, following a blueprint that won the Udaya 1.0 Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutrition assistant that parses local food intake and delivers personalized meal adjustments and healthy lifestyle guidance.
ideas.title: NutriAI Mealzy: Personalized Nutrition and Wellness Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the HealthCare track and leverages a first-prize winning formula from a fast-paced 24-hour sprint.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered trust engine and intake portal designed to streamline patient education and acquisition for specialized healthcare clinics.
ideas.title: GlobalSmile HealthTrust: AI Patient Acquisition for Specialized Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical utility for clinics with a polished LLM interface, a combination that routinely captures high marks in healthcare tracks.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-first image classification tool that assesses early-stage crop health and predicts local yield anomalies for food security initiatives.
ideas.title: AgriSnapp Yield: Mobile Crop Classification & Food Security Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a UN Reboot Earth Hackathon winning project by providing immediate, quantifiable insights into local food security.
